name: log2
comment: Sig: r = log2(...). Element-wise libm-backed primitive (SIMD via Highway hn::Log2). Negative scalar promotes to complex: log2(-1)==0+4.532i. ARRAY promotion (fixed 2026-06-05): any negative element promotes the WHOLE array — log2([-8 8])=[3+4.53236i 3+0i] (previously the negative became real NaN). Verified vs MATLAB R2025b.
